subject: POC trial plan & final readout scheduling - Veridian Bio
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@veridianbio.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + draft POC plan (next steps)

Tom / Lena — great speaking this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the trial kicks off:

1) Objective: validate Redwood inference for high-volume sequence-based batch workloads (variant annotation pipeline) with a focus on latency tail, throughput cost, and qualitative accuracy on our domain prompts.
2) Success criteria (draft):
   - 95th percentile latency under 450ms for 512-token prompts during steady-state throughput
   - Cost per 1k tokens <= $X (TBD after runtime profile)
   - Model pass rate: >= 90% on the agreed evaluation checklist for hallucination/format fidelity
3) Timeline:
   - Trial start: Mon Apr 19 (kickoff + env access)
   - 2-week evaluation window (Apr 19 - May 3)
   - Final readout + exec decision week of May 10
4) Ownership:
   - Veridian: Tom (technical lead), Lena (product stakeholder), Procurement for contract steps
   - Redwood: Marissa (AE, program lead), Marcus (solutions engineering), Neha (security/compliance lead)

I attached a short POC plan (redwood-poc-plan.pdf) with the evaluation checklist and a first-pass SOW. Can you confirm the success criteria above and that Apr 19 works for you for kickoff? If yes I’ll schedule the kickoff and loop in Eng.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@veridianbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridianbio.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + draft POC plan (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Confirming a few quick items:

- Success criteria look reasonable; I’ll validate the pass-rate threshold with our CS team (might push for 92% on hallucination checks).
- Apr 19 kickoff works on our side.
- Procurement will need the SOW + an estimated cost range before kickoff to open the purchase request. Can you get an updated SOW and rough pricing estimate?

I’ll also invite Sarah in procurement once I have internal approval to engage.

Tom
Tom Baxter | Head of Product, Veridian Bio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@veridianbio.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + draft POC plan (next steps)

Appreciate the quick reply Tom — noted on the 92% possibility. Marcus and I put together a more detailed evaluation plan + timeline and a SOW draft (attached). Key updates in the attached POC plan:

- Evaluation plan: split into 3 phases — ingestion + perf baseline (days 1-3), scale/perf stress (days 4-10), qualitative eval (days 11-14). Each phase has checklists and an owner.
- Data & access: we’ll need a test dataset (anonymized) and API keys. If the trial runs in your VPC, we’ll send a deployment spec.
- Metrics dashboard: Redwood will provide a temporary dashboard (token-level latency/cost, error rates, model outputs) accessible to the team.
- Pricing: included a ballpark for the trial usage in the SOW (hourly reserved + per-token estimate) — final pricing after we profile first 24 hours.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, sow-draft-veridian-v1.docx, evaluation-checklist.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm dataset availability and point of contact for procurement by Wed Apr 14
- Redwood schedules kickoff for Apr 19 (calendar invite sent once we lock procurement timing)
- Marcus to run pre-kickoff infra checks Apr 16-18

If that works I’ll publish the calendar invites and loop in Marcus for the technical pre-checks.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan prep + infra pre-checks

Marissa — noted. I’ll own the infra pre-checks and have a short checklist I’ll run Apr 16-18. Items include:
- Confirm VPC peering / egress rules if they run trial in Veridian VPC
- Validate dataset transfer method (S3 presigned vs VPN transfer)
- Provision demo model variant and quantization profile for perf testing
- Smoke test dashboard connectivity + RBAC for Veridian viewers

Question for Neha: any specific compliance docs we should proactively provide before procurement engages? I can drop a one-pager in the SOW to speed approval.

—Marcus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan prep + infra pre-checks

Marcus — please include:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (one-pager)
- Data handling & retention summary specific to trials
- Encryption & KMS notes for keys in transit and at rest

I’ll prepare redacted logs/examples and the SOC 2 summary so Tom can share with procurement quickly.

Neha
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridianbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Sarah Green <procurement@veridianbio.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + draft POC plan (next steps)

Hi all — quick update from Veridian execs after our internal readout this morning:

- Exec review scheduled for Thu May 13, 10:00am PT. They want the final trial readout slides and a short exec summary (1 slide + 2-3 key metrics) by Tue May 11 COB to circulate beforehand.
- Procurement (Sarah) asked for the final SOW and an estimated ramp contract by Fri May 7 to begin procurement intake.
- Go/no-go decision timeline: expect decision by Fri May 14 EOD; if positive, we’ll start contracting week of May 17.

We confirm Apr 19 kickoff — Tom will send the dataset and loop Sarah in separately. Thanks for the attachments and the plan; we’ll review and circle back with any substantive changes.

Lena
